description: Materials of part models, by the material name each model primitive carries (tools/blender). Colours are sRGB; metallic and roughness as in glTF PBR; emissive in sRGB times strength. `detail` (painted armour): plate seams, fasteners and wear the hull detail shader draws at real sizes: plate height and width/height, a structural seam every so many plates, seam width, fastener spacing, grime and overall strength.

armor.about: armour plates: dark military green, satin

armor2.about: second (lapped) armour plates: a lighter dark military green, satin

metal.about: machined steel: flanges, bearings, clamps; dark grey steel

dark.about: machinery: frame, housings, servos, rams, heat sinks; dark metallic grey

rubber.about: dust boots, hoses, grip pads, seals

trim.about: hazard yellow (warning stripes at pinch points)

beacon.about: red warning beacons on a giant frame's extremities (masts, shoulders, shell tops)
